Results are listed with the newest first. Put a phrase in quotes to match those words in that order. Add a minus sign before a word to leave out documents that use it, and use OR between two words to match either one. Minutes are added to the archive within a fortnight of each meeting, and older papers are scanned from the paper files. If a document you expect is not here, the clerk can look it up in the paper files kept at the village hall. Scanned papers before 1990 may read poorly, so a search can miss words that are in them; try a shorter phrase. Each result opens the document itself, so a long set of minutes may take a moment to load on a slow line.
